name: Trustworthy Scout
text: {1}{W}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Search your library for a card named Trustworthy Scout, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

name: Lurking Automaton
text:
Reveal this card as you draft it and note how many cards you've drafted this draft round, including this card.
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the highest number you noted for cards named Lurking Automaton.

name: Possessed Nomad
text:
Vigilance
Threshold — As long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+1, is black, and has "{2}{B}, {T}: Destroy target white creature."

name: Custodi Peacekeeper
text:
Reveal this card as you draft it and note how many cards you've drafted this draft round, including this card.
{W}, {T}: Tap target creature with power less than or equal to the highest number you noted for cards named Custodi Peacekeeper.

name: Spirit Weaver
text: {2}: Target green or blue creature gets +0/+1 until end of turn.

name: Paliano Vanguard
text:
Draft this card face up.
As you draft a creature card, you may reveal it, note its creature types, then turn this card face down.
Other creatures you control of a type you noted for cards named Paliano Vanguard get +1/+1.

name: Silkenfist Fighter
text: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, untap it.

name: Cogwork Grinder
text:
Draft this card face up.
As you draft a card, you may remove it from the draft face down. (Those cards aren't in your card pool.)
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of cards you removed from the draft with cards named Cogwork Grinder.

name: Charging Bandits
text: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

name: Noble Banneret
text:
Draft this card face up.
As you draft a creature card, you may reveal it, note its name, then turn this card face down.
As long as you control one or more creatures with a name you noted for cards named Noble Banneret, this creature and those creatures get +1/+1 and have lifelink.

name: Silkenfist Order
text: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, untap it.

name: Hall of Mirrors
text: Visit — Choose target creature you control. Each other creature you control becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it isn't legendary.

name: Information Booth
text: Visit — Draw a card.

name: Concession Stand
text: Visit — Create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.")

name: Haunted House
text: Visit — Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of your next end step.

name: Pick-a-Beeble
text:
Visit — Roll a six-sided die. Put a number of luck counters on Pick-a-Beeble equal to the result and create a Treasure token. Then if there are six or more luck counters on Pick-a-Beeble, claim the prize!
Prize — Create two Treasure tokens, then sacrifice Pick-a-Beeble and open an Attraction.

name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
text: Visit — Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. That creature gains vigilance until end of turn.

name: Balloon Stand
text:
Visit — Choose one.
• Create a 1/1 red Balloon creature token with flying.
• Sacrifice a Balloon. If you do, target creature gains flying until end of turn.

name: Trash Bin
text: Visit — Mill two cards, then return a card at random from your graveyard to your hand. (To mill a card, a player puts the top card of their library into their graveyard.)

name: Swinging Ship
text: Visit — After the first combat phase this turn, there's an additional combat phase. At the beginning of that combat, untap all creatures that attacked this turn.

name: Tunnel of Love
text: Visit — Choose an opponent. They choose a creature they control, then you choose a creature you control. You may exile the chosen creatures. If you do, return them to the battlefield under their owners' control at the beginning of the next end step. Otherwise, the chosen creatures fight each other.

name: Ferris Wheel
text: Visit — Choose target creature that hasn't been phased out with this Attraction. That creature phases out until you roll a 3 or less while rolling to visit your Attractions.

name: Clown Extruder
text: Visit — Create a 1/1 white Clown Robot artifact creature token.

name: Storybook Ride
text: Visit — Exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of Attractions you've visited this turn (including this one). You may play those cards this turn. At the beginning of the next end step, if any of those cards remain exiled, put them on the bottom of your library in any order.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Visit — Scry 1.

name: Bounce Chamber
text: Visit — Return a creature you don't control with the lowest toughness among creatures you don't control to its owner's hand. (If multiple creatures are tied, choose any one of them.)

name: Merry-Go-Round
text: Visit — Creatures you control with power 2 or less gain horsemanship until end of turn. (They can't be blocked except by creatures with horsemanship.)

name: Kiddie Coaster
text: Visit — Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

name: Bumper Cars
text: Visit — Target creature must be blocked this turn if able.

name: Costume Shop
text: Visit — You may put a sticker on a nonland permanent you own.

name: Roller Coaster
text: Visit — Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.

name: Drop Tower
text: Visit — Target creature gains flying until end of turn, or until any player rolls a 1, whichever comes first.

name: Spinny Ride
text: Visit — Tap target creature an opponent controls.
